name: Drain Claims And Pops Under One Lock

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: native release build, criterion benches (macOS arm64)
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Drain Claims And Pops Under One Lock Hypothesis

### Hypothesis

`DeliveryQueue::drain` locks once to claim the drain (`delivering = true`), again to pop the first item and snapshot, and once more to find the queue empty: three mutex round trips to deliver a single item, paid by every Signal write, source publish and `OrderedEmitter` batch. Popping the first item in the same critical section that claims the drain removes one round trip per drain with identical ordering and re-entrancy.

### Scope Lock

**Tested mechanism:** fuse the drain claim with the first pop.
**Allowed changes:** `DeliveryQueue::drain` in `crates/src/primitives/delivery.rs`.
**Forbidden in this experiment:** `enqueue` fusion, snapshot changes, subscriber-count changes.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

`primitives::tests` (ordered and panic-safe delivery), full lib + integration tests; clippy/fmt. Bench `hot_paths`, `delivery_complexity`, `reactive_complexity` vs base, rerun on borderline. Pass: `signal-set-one-subscriber` or `delivery-queue-fanout/enqueue/1` >=5% faster, nothing slower >10% on rerun.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

~5-10 ns less per delivered item on single-item drains.
